tcp_trajectory_error_m.source: retained D40/D41 path-deviation gate; diagnostic only

terminal_orientation_error_rad.source: D46 documented diagnostic threshold; not a hardware certification threshold

terminal_position_error_m.source: retained D40/D41 geometry gate; diagnostic only

diagnostic_thresholds.velocity_acceleration_jerk_hard_limit: configured per-joint values below; provenance controls whether a physical claim is allowed

environment: native D41 MoveIt2 world built from the authoritative open-arch target poses; tunnel floor included; bottom closure excluded by open-path scope

families.ADVERSARIAL: high-curvature short-horizon stress and 20 deliberate j3 bound-invalid controls
families.BOUNDARY: predeclared bounded pushes to URDF position boundaries plus fixed duration scaling
families.COLLISION_SENSITIVE: predeclared smooth excursions toward a known native self-collision state
families.NORMAL: small smooth bounded variations around the actual frozen D41 post-Ruckig path
families.REGRESSION: actual frozen post-Ruckig and pre-Ruckig Stage 3 trajectory replay controls

library_versions.bullet: native MoveIt2 backend; exact package version not separately exposed
library_versions.ruckig: native MoveIt2 Ruckig header/API; exact package version not separately exposed

measurement_protocol.continuous_self_collision: not_available; dense adaptive discrete self checks retained separately
measurement_protocol.dynamics: kinematic velocity/acceleration/jerk from actual post-Ruckig states or declared numerical differentiation; model-based torque unavailable
measurement_protocol.fk: native MoveIt2 RobotState FK for spray_tcp_link
measurement_protocol.native_environment_two_state_query: MoveIt2 CollisionEnvBullet checkRobotCollision(state1,state2) recorded separately when available
measurement_protocol.native_geometry_sampling: waypoint states plus adaptive 0.5-degree joint-space interpolation
measurement_protocol.post_ruckig: actual D41 strict replay artifact for regression_0000 and repeated regression controls; perturbation/stress cases are audit-only state perturbations

seed_policy: all cases use explicit integer seeds; NumPy PCG64 generator seed is 460046 for perturbation draws
